tsql: SELECT d_labitems.label FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.itemid IN (SELECT T3.itemid FROM (SELECT T2.itemid AS itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'noncompliance with renal dialysis') AND dbo.MET_BY(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, labevents.itemid AS itemid, labevents.charttime AS charttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM labevents JOIN admissions ON labevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.MET_BY(labevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id GROUP BY T2.itemid) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5)
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'noncompliance with renal dialysis' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ labevents ] Output [ hadm_id , itemid , charttime ] ; #6 = Filter [ #5 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , itemid , charttime ] ; #7 = Join [ #4 , #6 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #6.hadm_id AND #4.charttime < #6.charttime ] Output [ #6.hadm_id , #6.itemid ] ; #8 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #9 = Join [ #7 , #8 ] Predicate [ #7.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id ] Output [ #8.subject_id , #7.hadm_id , #7.itemid ] ; #10 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #11 = Join [ #9 , #10 ] Predicate [ #9.hadm_id = #10.hadm_id AND #9.subject_id = #10.subject_id ] Output [ #9.itemid ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ itemid ] Output [ itemid , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ itemid , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 5 ] Output [ itemid ] ; #15 = Scan Table [ d_labitems ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #16 = Join [ #14 , #15 ] Predicate [ #14.itemid = #15.itemid ] Output [ #15.label ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'noncompliance with renal dialysis' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Filter_3.hadm_id, Filter_3.charttime FROM Scan_1 JOIN Filter_3 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Filter_3.icd_code ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.labevents ), Filter_6 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid, charttime FROM Scan_5 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_7 AS ( SELECT Filter_6.hadm_id, Filter_6.itemid FROM Join_4 JOIN Filter_6 ON Join_4.hadm_id = Filter_6.hadm_id AND Join_4.charttime < Filter_6.charttime ), Scan_8 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_9 AS ( SELECT Scan_8.subject_id, Join_7.hadm_id, Join_7.itemid FROM Join_7 JOIN Scan_8 ON Join_7.hadm_id = Scan_8.hadm_id ), Scan_10 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_11 AS ( SELECT Join_9.itemid FROM Join_9 JOIN Scan_10 ON Join_9.hadm_id = Scan_10.hadm_id AND Join_9.subject_id = Scan_10.subject_id ), Aggregate_12 AS ( SELECT itemid, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_11 GROUP BY itemid ), SequenceProject_13 AS ( SELECT itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_12 ), Filter_14 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM SequenceProject_13 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 5 ), Scan_15 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_labitems ), Join_16 AS ( SELECT Scan_15.label FROM Filter_14 JOIN Scan_15 ON Filter_14.itemid = Scan_15.itemid ) SELECT * FROM Join_16

question: Give me the length of stay in days for patient 10018501 during their first stay in the ICU.
sqlite: SELECT strftime('%J', icustays.outtime) - strftime('%J', icustays.intime) FROM icustays WHERE icustays.hadm_id IN ( SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10018501 ) AND icustays.outtime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY icustays.intime ASC LIMIT 1

question: Retrieve the top three most frequent medications that patients were prescribed in the same month after being diagnosed with cerebral edema.
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'cerebral edema' ) ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.starttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
sqlite_ans: potassium chloride replacement (critical care and oncology)

tsql_ans: potassium chloride replacement (critical care and oncology)
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'cerebral edema' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Join [ #1 , #2 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #2.icd_code ] Output [ #2.hadm_id , #2.charttime ] ; #4 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #5 = Join [ #3 , #4 ] Predicate [ #3.hadm_id = #4.hadm_id ] Output [ #3.charttime , #4.subject_id ] ; #6 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #7 = Join [ #5 , #6 ] Predicate [ #5.subject_id = #6.subject_id ] Output [ #5.charttime , #6.hadm_id ] ; #8 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #9 = Join [ #7 , #8 ] Predicate [ #8.hadm_id = #7.hadm_id AND #7.charttime < #8.starttime AND #7.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#8.starttime, 'month') ] Output [ #8.drug ] ; #10 = Aggregate [ #9 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #11 = SequenceProject [ #10 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #12 = Filter [ #11 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ drug ]

question: What are the five frequently tested specimens for patients that received insertion of intraluminal device into inferior vena cava, percutaneous approach previously within the same hospital visit since 2100?

question: What were the three most common drugs prescribed throughout this year?

question: What is the white blood cells percentile of 12.1 among patients of the same age as patient 10001217 on their last hospital visit?

question: What are the top five most common specimens being tested for patients who were diagnosed with transfusion related acute lung injury (trali) within 2 months since 1 year ago?
sqlite: SELECT T3.spec_type_desc FROM ( SELECT T2.spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'transfusion related acute lung injury (trali)' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc, microbiologyevents.charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE datetime(microbiologyevents.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND datetime(T2.charttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.spec_type_desc ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5

question: What was the name of the drug patient 10021118 was prescribed with within 2 days after having received a performance of cardiac output, continuous procedure in this month?

question: Among patients diagnosed with esophagitis, unspecified, what were the top four most common microbiology tests conducted within the same hospital visit in this year?

question: For patients diagnosed with hemorrhage of rectum and anus throughout this year, what are the top five most recurrent treatments within 2 months?

question: What was the name of the drug which was prescribed to patient 10020740 within 2 days after having received a endoscopic removal of stone(s) from biliary tract procedure since 9 months ago?
sqlite: SELECT T2.drug FROM ( SELECT procedures_icd.charttime, procedures_icd.hadm_id FROM procedures_icd WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'endoscopic removal of stone(s) from biliary tract' ) AND procedures_icd.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10020740 ) AND datetime(procedures_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-9 month') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime, prescriptions.hadm_id FROM prescriptions WHERE prescriptions.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10020740 ) AND datetime(prescriptions.starttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-9 month') ) AS T2 ON T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T2.starttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 day')
tsql: SELECT T2.drug FROM (SELECT procedures_icd.charttime AS charttime, procedures_icd.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM procedures_icd WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'endoscopic removal of stone(s) from biliary tract') AND procedures_icd.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10020740) AND dbo.MET_BY(procedures_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(month, -9, GETDATE()))) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime, prescriptions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM prescriptions WHERE prescriptions.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10020740) AND dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(month, -9, GETDATE()))) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 day')) = 1
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_procedures ] Predicate [ long_title = 'endoscopic removal of stone(s) from biliary tract' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ subject_id = 10020740 ] Output [ hadm_id , subject_id ] ; #3 = Scan Table [ procedures_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Filter [ #3 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(month, -9, getdate())) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #5 = Join [ #2 , #4 ] Predicate [ #2.hadm_id = #4.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.icd_code , #4.charttime , #2.hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #1 , #5 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #5.icd_code ] Output [ #5.charttime , #5.hadm_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #8 = Filter [ #7 ] Predicate [ starttime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(month, -9, getdate())) ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #9 = Join [ #6 , #8 ] Predicate [ #6.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #6.charttime < #8.starttime AND #8.starttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#6.charttime, 'within +2 day') ] Output [ #8.hadm_id , #8.drug ] ; #10 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ subject_id = 10020740 ] Output [ hadm_id , subject_id ] ; #11 = Intersect [ #9 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #9.hadm_id ] Output [ #9.drug ]

question: Retrieve the monthly minimum amount of patient 10001725's pre-admission/non-icu intake input since 03/12/2100.

question: What are the four most commonly tested specimens for patients who were diagnosed with chronic lymphocytic leukemia of b-cell type not having achieved remission previously in the same month, in 2100?

question: What percentile is mchc 32.2 among patients of the same age as patient 10027602 during their first hospital encounter?

tsql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT T1.subject_id) FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'acquired absence of breast and nipple') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'unilateral simple mastectomy') AND dbo.DURING(procedures_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND dbo.DURING(T1.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T2.charttime, 'month')) = 1
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'acquired absence of breast and nipple' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ d_icd_procedures ] Predicate [ long_title = 'unilateral simple mastectomy' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #3 = Scan Table [ procedures_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Filter [ #3 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #5 = Join [ #2 , #4 ] Predicate [ #2.icd_code = #4.icd_code ] Output [ #4.hadm_id , #4.charttime ] ; #6 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #7 = Join [ #5 , #6 ] Predicate [ #5.hadm_id = #6.hadm_id ] Output [ #5.charttime , #6.subject_id ] ; #8 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #9 = Join [ #7 , #8 ] Predicate [ #7.subject_id = #8.subject_id ] Output [ #7.subject_id , #8.hadm_id , #7.charttime ] ; #10 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #11 = Filter [ #10 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #12 = Join [ #9 , #11 ] Predicate [ #9.hadm_id = #11.hadm_id AND #11.charttime < #9.charttime AND #11.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#9.charttime, 'month') ] Output [ #11.icd_code , #9.subject_id ] ; #13 = Join [ #1 , #12 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #12.icd_code ] Distinct [ true ] Output [ #12.subject_id ] ; #14 = Aggregate [ #13 ] Output [ countstar AS Count_Star ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'acquired absence of breast and nipple' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_procedures WHERE long_title = 'unilateral simple mastectomy' ), Scan_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.procedures_icd ), Filter_4 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_3 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_5 AS ( SELECT Filter_4.hadm_id, Filter_4.charttime FROM Scan_2 JOIN Filter_4 ON Scan_2.icd_code = Filter_4.icd_code ), Scan_6 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_7 AS ( SELECT Join_5.charttime, Scan_6.subject_id FROM Join_5 JOIN Scan_6 ON Join_5.hadm_id = Scan_6.hadm_id ), Scan_8 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_9 AS ( SELECT Join_7.subject_id, Scan_8.hadm_id, Join_7.charttime FROM Join_7 JOIN Scan_8 ON Join_7.subject_id = Scan_8.subject_id ), Scan_10 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_11 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_10 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_12 AS ( SELECT Filter_11.icd_code, Join_9.subject_id FROM Join_9 JOIN Filter_11 ON Join_9.hadm_id = Filter_11.hadm_id AND Filter_11.charttime < Join_9.charttime AND dbo.DURING(Filter_11.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(Join_9.charttime, 'month')) = 1 ), Join_13 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT Join_12.subject_id FROM Scan_1 JOIN Join_12 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Join_12.icd_code ), Aggregate_14 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_13 ) SELECT * FROM Aggregate_14

question: For patients previously diagnosed with migraine with aura, without mention of intractable migraine without mention of status migrainosus , what were the three most frequent specimens tested within 2 months afterward?

tsql: SELECT T3.spec_type_desc FROM (SELECT T2.spec_type_desc AS spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'migraine with aura, without mention of intractable migraine without mention of status migrainosus')) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc AS spec_type_desc, microbiologyevents.charttime AS charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.spec_type_desc) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'migraine with aura, without mention of intractable migraine without mention of status migrainosus' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Join [ #1 , #2 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #2.icd_code ] Output [ #2.hadm_id , #2.charttime ] ; #4 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #5 = Join [ #3 , #4 ] Predicate [ #3.hadm_id = #4.hadm_id ] Output [ #3.charttime , #4.subject_id ] ; #6 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #7 = Join [ #5 , #6 ] Predicate [ #5.subject_id = #6.subject_id ] Output [ #5.charttime , #6.hadm_id ] ; #8 = Scan Table [ microbiologyevents ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #9 = Join [ #7 , #8 ] Predicate [ #8.hadm_id = #7.hadm_id AND #7.charttime < #8.charttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#7.charttime, 'within +2 month') ] Output [ #8.spec_type_desc ] ; #10 = Aggregate [ #9 ] GroupBy [ spec_type_desc ] Output [ spec_type_desc , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #11 = SequenceProject [ #10 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ spec_type_desc , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #12 = Filter [ #11 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ spec_type_desc ]

question: During this year, what are the top three most common medications prescribed during the same month to the patients aged 60 or above after they were diagnosed with leukocytosis, unspecified?

question: What are the top four most common specimens tested for patients previously diagnosed with traumatic shock within 2 months?
sqlite: SELECT T3.spec_type_desc FROM ( SELECT T2.spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'traumatic shock' ) ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc, microbiologyevents.charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND datetime(T2.charttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.spec_type_desc ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4

qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'traumatic shock' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Join [ #1 , #2 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #2.icd_code ] Output [ #2.hadm_id , #2.charttime ] ; #4 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #5 = Join [ #3 , #4 ] Predicate [ #3.hadm_id = #4.hadm_id ] Output [ #3.charttime , #4.subject_id ] ; #6 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #7 = Join [ #5 , #6 ] Predicate [ #5.subject_id = #6.subject_id ] Output [ #5.charttime , #6.hadm_id ] ; #8 = Scan Table [ microbiologyevents ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #9 = Join [ #7 , #8 ] Predicate [ #8.hadm_id = #7.hadm_id AND #7.charttime < #8.charttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#7.charttime, 'within +2 month') ] Output [ #8.spec_type_desc ] ; #10 = Aggregate [ #9 ] GroupBy [ spec_type_desc ] Output [ spec_type_desc , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #11 = SequenceProject [ #10 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ spec_type_desc , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #12 = Filter [ #11 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 4 ] Output [ spec_type_desc ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'traumatic shock' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Join_3 AS ( SELECT Scan_2.hadm_id, Scan_2.charttime FROM Scan_1 JOIN Scan_2 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Scan_2.icd_code ), Scan_4 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_5 AS ( SELECT Join_3.charttime, Scan_4.subject_id FROM Join_3 JOIN Scan_4 ON Join_3.hadm_id = Scan_4.hadm_id ), Scan_6 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_7 AS ( SELECT Join_5.charttime, Scan_6.hadm_id FROM Join_5 JOIN Scan_6 ON Join_5.subject_id = Scan_6.subject_id ), Scan_8 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, charttime, spec_type_desc FROM mimic_iv.dbo.microbiologyevents ), Join_9 AS ( SELECT Scan_8.spec_type_desc FROM Join_7 JOIN Scan_8 ON Scan_8.hadm_id = Join_7.hadm_id AND Join_7.charttime < Scan_8.charttime AND dbo.DURING(Scan_8.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(Join_7.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 ), Aggregate_10 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_9 GROUP BY spec_type_desc ), SequenceProject_11 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_10 ), Filter_12 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc FROM SequenceProject_11 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 4 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_12

tsql: SELECT T2.drug FROM (SELECT procedures_icd.charttime AS charttime, procedures_icd.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM procedures_icd WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'excision of left saphenous vein, percutaneous endoscopic approach') AND procedures_icd.hadm_id IN (SELECT TOP 1 admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10022017 AND NOT admissions.dischtime IS NULL ORDER BY admissions.admittime DESC)) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime, prescriptions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM prescriptions WHERE prescriptions.hadm_id IN (SELECT TOP 1 admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10022017 AND NOT admissions.dischtime IS NULL ORDER BY admissions.admittime DESC)) AS T2 ON T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 day')) = 1

tsql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT admissions.subject_id) FROM admissions WHERE admissions.hadm_id IN (SELECT transfers.hadm_id FROM transfers WHERE transfers.careunit = 'vascular' AND dbo.MET_BY(transfers.intime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1)
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ transfers ] Predicate [ careunit = 'vascular' ] Output [ hadm_id , intime , careunit ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ intime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id ] ; #4 = Intersect [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #3.hadm_id = #1.hadm_id ] Distinct [ true ] Output [ #1.subject_id ] ; #5 = Aggregate [ #4 ] Output [ countstar AS Count_Star ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, intime, careunit FROM mimic_iv.dbo.transfers WHERE careunit = 'vascular' ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(intime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Intersect_4 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT Scan_1.subject_id FROM Scan_1 WHERE hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM Filter_3) ), Aggregate_5 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Intersect_4 ) SELECT * FROM Aggregate_5

question: Tell me the five most common microbiology tests for patients who were previously diagnosed with coronary atherosclerosis of autologous vein bypass graft in the same month in 2100.
sqlite: SELECT T3.test_name FROM ( SELECT T2.test_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'coronary atherosclerosis of autologous vein bypass graft' ) AND strftime('%Y',diagnoses_icd.charttime) = '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, microbiologyevents.test_name, microbiologyevents.charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE strftime('%Y',microbiologyevents.charttime) = '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.charttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.test_name ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5
tsql: SELECT T3.test_name FROM (SELECT T2.test_name AS test_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'coronary atherosclerosis of autologous vein bypass graft') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, microbiologyevents.test_name AS test_name, microbiologyevents.charttime AS charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.DURING(microbiologyevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND dbo.DURING(T1.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T2.charttime, 'month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.test_name) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'coronary atherosclerosis of autologous vein bypass graft' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ microbiologyevents ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , test_name ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , test_name ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.charttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#10.charttime, 'month') ] Output [ #10.test_name ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ test_name ] Output [ test_name , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ test_name , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 5 ] Output [ test_name ]

cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT admittime, age, subject_id, dischtime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions WHERE subject_id = 10007818 AND dischtime IS NOT NULL ), TopSort_2 AS ( SELECT TOP 1 admittime, age FROM Scan_1 ORDER BY admittime DESC ), Scan_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, age FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Scan_3.hadm_id FROM TopSort_2 JOIN Scan_3 ON TopSort_2.age = Scan_3.age ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_labitems WHERE label = 'calcium, total' ), Scan_6 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid, valuenum FROM mimic_iv.dbo.labevents ), Join_7 AS ( SELECT Scan_6.hadm_id, Scan_6.valuenum FROM Scan_5 JOIN Scan_6 ON Scan_5.itemid = Scan_6.itemid ), Join_8 AS ( SELECT Join_7.valuenum FROM Join_4 JOIN Join_7 ON Join_4.hadm_id = Join_7.hadm_id ), SequenceProject_9 AS ( SELECT valuenum, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY valuenum ASC) AS percent_rank_1 FROM Join_8 ), Filter_10 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT percent_rank_1 FROM SequenceProject_9 WHERE valuenum = 9.3 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_10

question: What are the three commonly ordered medications for patients who were diagnosed with atrial fibrillation previously in the same hospital visit, in this year?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime, admissions.hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'atrial fibrillation' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime, admissions.hadm_id FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE datetime(prescriptions.starttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'atrial fibrillation') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.DURING(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'atrial fibrillation' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id , #5.hadm_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.hadm_id = #7.hadm_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #6.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ starttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.starttime ] Output [ #10.drug ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ drug ]

question: What are the three frequently prescribed medications in the same month to the patients aged 40s after diagnosed with coronary atherosclerosis of native coronary artery throughout this year?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'coronary atherosclerosis of native coronary artery' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 AND datetime(prescriptions.starttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.starttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'coronary atherosclerosis of native coronary artery') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 AND dbo.DURING(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T1.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T2.starttime, 'month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'coronary atherosclerosis of native coronary artery' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ age >= 40 AND age <= 49 ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id , age ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ starttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.starttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#10.starttime, 'month') ] Output [ #10.drug ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ drug ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'coronary atherosclerosis of native coronary artery' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(getdate(), 'year')) = 1 ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Filter_3.hadm_id, Filter_3.charttime FROM Scan_1 JOIN Filter_3 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Filter_3.icd_code ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_6 AS ( SELECT Join_4.charttime, Scan_5.subject_id FROM Join_4 JOIN Scan_5 ON Join_4.hadm_id = Scan_5.hadm_id ), Scan_7 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id, age FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions WHERE age >= 40 AND age <= 49 ), Join_8 AS ( SELECT Join_6.charttime, Scan_7.hadm_id FROM Join_6 JOIN Scan_7 ON Join_6.subject_id = Scan_7.subject_id ), Scan_9 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions ), Filter_10 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM Scan_9 WHERE dbo.DURING(starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(getdate(), 'year')) = 1 ), Join_11 AS ( SELECT Filter_10.drug FROM Join_8 JOIN Filter_10 ON Filter_10.hadm_id = Join_8.hadm_id AND Join_8.charttime < Filter_10.starttime AND dbo.DURING(Join_8.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(Filter_10.starttime, 'month')) = 1 ), Aggregate_12 AS ( SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_11 GROUP BY drug ), SequenceProject_13 AS ( SELECT drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_12 ), Filter_14 AS ( SELECT drug FROM SequenceProject_13 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 3 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_14

question: Display the top five most commonly prescribed drugs since 1 year ago.

question: In 2100, what are the top five most common specimens tested for patients previously diagnosed with personal history of self-harm within the same month?
sqlite: SELECT T3.spec_type_desc FROM ( SELECT T2.spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'personal history of self-harm' ) AND strftime('%Y',diagnoses_icd.charttime) = '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc, microbiologyevents.charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE strftime('%Y',microbiologyevents.charttime) = '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.charttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.spec_type_desc ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5

qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'personal history of self-harm' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ microbiologyevents ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.charttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#10.charttime, 'month') ] Output [ #10.spec_type_desc ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ spec_type_desc ] Output [ spec_type_desc , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ spec_type_desc , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 5 ] Output [ spec_type_desc ]

question: What are the top four most frequently prescribed drugs?

tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'duodenitis, without mention of hemorrhage') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.DURING(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T1.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T2.starttime, 'month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'duodenitis, without mention of hemorrhage' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ starttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.starttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#10.starttime, 'month') ] Output [ #10.drug ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ drug ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'duodenitis, without mention of hemorrhage' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Filter_3.hadm_id, Filter_3.charttime FROM Scan_1 JOIN Filter_3 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Filter_3.icd_code ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_6 AS ( SELECT Join_4.charttime, Scan_5.subject_id FROM Join_4 JOIN Scan_5 ON Join_4.hadm_id = Scan_5.hadm_id ), Scan_7 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_8 AS ( SELECT Join_6.charttime, Scan_7.hadm_id FROM Join_6 JOIN Scan_7 ON Join_6.subject_id = Scan_7.subject_id ), Scan_9 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions ), Filter_10 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM Scan_9 WHERE dbo.DURING(starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_11 AS ( SELECT Filter_10.drug FROM Join_8 JOIN Filter_10 ON Filter_10.hadm_id = Join_8.hadm_id AND Join_8.charttime < Filter_10.starttime AND dbo.DURING(Join_8.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(Filter_10.starttime, 'month')) = 1 ), Aggregate_12 AS ( SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_11 GROUP BY drug ), SequenceProject_13 AS ( SELECT drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_12 ), Filter_14 AS ( SELECT drug FROM SequenceProject_13 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 3 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_14

question: When was the last time that on the last hospital stay patient 10021312 was prescribed a medication via po?
sqlite: SELECT prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions WHERE prescriptions.hadm_id IN ( SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10021312 AND admissions.dischtime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY admissions.admittime DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND prescriptions.route = 'po' ORDER BY prescriptions.starttime DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the last time in 03/this year patient 10019777 had the maximum absolute monocyte count.
sqlite: SELECT labevents.charttime FROM labevents WHERE labevents.hadm_id IN ( SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10019777 ) AND labevents.itemid IN ( SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'absolute monocyte count' ) AND datetime(labevents.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') AND strftime('%m',labevents.charttime) = '03' ORDER BY labevents.valuenum DESC, labevents.charttime DESC LIMIT 1
tsql: SELECT TOP 1 labevents.charttime FROM labevents WHERE labevents.hadm_id IN (SELECT admissions.hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE admissions.subject_id = 10019777) AND labevents.itemid IN (SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'absolute monocyte count') AND dbo.DURING(labevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(YEAR(GETDATE()), 03, NULL)) = 1 ORDER BY labevents.valuenum DESC, labevents.charttime DESC

cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_labitems WHERE label = 'absolute monocyte count' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, subject_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions WHERE subject_id = 10019777 ), Scan_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid, charttime, valuenum FROM mimic_iv.dbo.labevents ), Filter_4 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid, charttime, valuenum FROM Scan_3 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(year(getdate()), 3, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_5 AS ( SELECT Filter_4.itemid, Filter_4.charttime, Filter_4.valuenum FROM Scan_2 JOIN Filter_4 ON Scan_2.hadm_id = Filter_4.hadm_id ), Join_6 AS ( SELECT Join_5.charttime, Join_5.valuenum FROM Scan_1 JOIN Join_5 ON Scan_1.itemid = Join_5.itemid ), TopSort_7 AS ( SELECT TOP 1 charttime FROM Join_6 ORDER BY valuenum DESC , charttime DESC ) SELECT * FROM TopSort_7

question: Could you provide me with the three most frequent output events this year?
sqlite: SELECT d_items.label FROM d_items WHERE d_items.itemid IN ( SELECT T1.itemid FROM ( SELECT outputevents.itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM outputevents WHERE datetime(outputevents.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') GROUP BY outputevents.itemid ) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 3 )
tsql: SELECT d_items.label FROM d_items WHERE d_items.itemid IN (SELECT T1.itemid FROM (SELECT outputevents.itemid AS itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM outputevents WHERE dbo.DURING(outputevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1 GROUP BY outputevents.itemid) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 3)
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_items ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ outputevents ] Output [ charttime , itemid ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ itemid ] ; #4 = Aggregate [ #3 ] GroupBy [ itemid ] Output [ itemid , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #5 = SequenceProject [ #4 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ itemid , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #6 = Filter [ #5 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ itemid ] ; #7 = Intersect [ #1 , #6 ] Predicate [ #6.itemid = #1.itemid ] Output [ #1.label ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_items ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT charttime, itemid FROM mimic_iv.dbo.outputevents ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(getdate(), 'year')) = 1 ), Aggregate_4 AS ( SELECT itemid, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Filter_3 GROUP BY itemid ), SequenceProject_5 AS ( SELECT itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_4 ), Filter_6 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM SequenceProject_5 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 3 ), Intersect_7 AS ( SELECT Scan_1.label FROM Scan_1 WHERE itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM Filter_6) ) SELECT * FROM Intersect_7

question: What are the four most frequently tested specimens for patients that received arteriography of other intra-abdominal arteries previously within 2 months since 2100?

tsql: SELECT T3.spec_type_desc FROM (SELECT T2.spec_type_desc AS spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'arteriography of other intra-abdominal arteries') AND dbo.MET_BY(procedures_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc AS spec_type_desc, microbiologyevents.charttime AS charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.MET_BY(microbiologyevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.spec_type_desc) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4

question: Tell me the total number of patients in pacu since 2100.

question: Which are the top three most frequent procedures patients had within 2 months after being diagnosed with personal history of malignant neoplasm of large intestine since 1 year ago?
sqlite: SELECT d_icd_procedures.long_title FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.icd_code IN ( SELECT T3.icd_code FROM ( SELECT T2.icd_code, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'personal history of malignant neoplasm of large intestine' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, procedures_icd.icd_code, procedures_icd.charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE datetime(procedures_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND datetime(T2.charttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.icd_code ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3 )

question: What are the four most common diagnoses for patients who previously had the dilation of right main bronchus with intraluminal device, via natural or artificial opening endoscopic procedure within 2 months since 1 year ago?

question: What are the three frequently prescribed medications within 2 months to the patients aged 60 or above after diagnosed with chronic kidney disease, unspecified since 1 year ago?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'chronic kidney disease, unspecified' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age >= 60 AND datetime(prescriptions.starttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T2.starttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'chronic kidney disease, unspecified') AND dbo.MET_BY(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age >= 60 AND dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'chronic kidney disease, unspecified' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate())) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ age >= 60 ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id , age ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ starttime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate())) ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.starttime AND #10.starttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#8.charttime, 'within +2 month') ] Output [ #10.drug ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ drug ]

tsql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM procedures_icd WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'dilation of left external iliac vein with intraluminal device, percutaneous approach') AND dbo.DURING(procedures_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_procedures ] Predicate [ long_title = 'dilation of left external iliac vein with intraluminal device, percutaneous approach' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ procedures_icd ] Output [ icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #1.icd_code ] ; #5 = Aggregate [ #4 ] Output [ countstar AS Count_Star ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_procedures WHERE long_title = 'dilation of left external iliac vein with intraluminal device, percutaneous approach' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.procedures_icd ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Scan_1.icd_code FROM Scan_1 JOIN Filter_3 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Filter_3.icd_code ), Aggregate_5 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_4 ) SELECT * FROM Aggregate_5

question: Show me the top three most commonly prescribed drugs within 2 months to the patients aged 60 or above after diagnosed with do not resuscitate since 2100.
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'do not resuscitate' ) AND strftime('%Y',diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age >= 60 AND strftime('%Y',prescriptions.starttime) >= '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T2.starttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
sqlite_ans: potassium chloride replacement (critical care and oncology)
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'do not resuscitate') AND dbo.MET_BY(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age >= 60 AND dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
tsql_ans: potassium chloride replacement (critical care and oncology)

question: Among patients diagnosed with diabetes mellitus without mention of complication, type ii or unspecified type, not stated as uncontrolled since 1 year ago, what are the top five medications prescribed within 2 months to patients in their 40s?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'diabetes mellitus without mention of complication, type ii or unspecified type, not stated as uncontrolled' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 AND datetime(prescriptions.starttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T2.starttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'diabetes mellitus without mention of complication, type ii or unspecified type, not stated as uncontrolled') AND dbo.MET_BY(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 AND dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5

question: Name the three most frequently prescribed drugs during the same hospital encounter following a diagnosis of acute and subacute necrosis of liver during this year.

question: What are the four most commonly prescribed medications for patients diagnosed with monoclonal gammopathy previously within the same month, throughout this year?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'monoclonal gammopathy' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE datetime(prescriptions.starttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.starttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4
sqlite_ans: potassium chloride replacement (critical care and oncology)

question: Among patients diagnosed with other diseases of lung, not elsewhere classified, what are the top three most common lab tests conducted within the same hospital visit in this year?

tsql: SELECT d_labitems.label FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.itemid IN (SELECT T3.itemid FROM (SELECT T2.itemid AS itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'other diseases of lung, not elsewhere classified') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, labevents.itemid AS itemid, labevents.charttime AS charttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM labevents JOIN admissions ON labevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.DURING(labevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id GROUP BY T2.itemid) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3)
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'other diseases of lung, not elsewhere classified' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ labevents ] Output [ hadm_id , itemid , charttime ] ; #6 = Filter [ #5 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , itemid , charttime ] ; #7 = Join [ #4 , #6 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #6.hadm_id AND #4.charttime < #6.charttime ] Output [ #6.hadm_id , #6.itemid ] ; #8 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #9 = Join [ #7 , #8 ] Predicate [ #7.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id ] Output [ #8.subject_id , #7.hadm_id , #7.itemid ] ; #10 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #11 = Join [ #9 , #10 ] Predicate [ #9.hadm_id = #10.hadm_id AND #9.subject_id = #10.subject_id ] Output [ #9.itemid ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ itemid ] Output [ itemid , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ itemid , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ itemid ] ; #15 = Scan Table [ d_labitems ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #16 = Join [ #14 , #15 ] Predicate [ #14.itemid = #15.itemid ] Output [ #15.label ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'other diseases of lung, not elsewhere classified' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(getdate(), 'year')) = 1 ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Filter_3.hadm_id, Filter_3.charttime FROM Scan_1 JOIN Filter_3 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Filter_3.icd_code ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.labevents ), Filter_6 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, itemid, charttime FROM Scan_5 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(getdate(), 'year')) = 1 ), Join_7 AS ( SELECT Filter_6.hadm_id, Filter_6.itemid FROM Join_4 JOIN Filter_6 ON Join_4.hadm_id = Filter_6.hadm_id AND Join_4.charttime < Filter_6.charttime ), Scan_8 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_9 AS ( SELECT Scan_8.subject_id, Join_7.hadm_id, Join_7.itemid FROM Join_7 JOIN Scan_8 ON Join_7.hadm_id = Scan_8.hadm_id ), Scan_10 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_11 AS ( SELECT Join_9.itemid FROM Join_9 JOIN Scan_10 ON Join_9.hadm_id = Scan_10.hadm_id AND Join_9.subject_id = Scan_10.subject_id ), Aggregate_12 AS ( SELECT itemid, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_11 GROUP BY itemid ), SequenceProject_13 AS ( SELECT itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_12 ), Filter_14 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM SequenceProject_13 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 3 ), Scan_15 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_labitems ), Join_16 AS ( SELECT Scan_15.label FROM Filter_14 JOIN Scan_15 ON Filter_14.itemid = Scan_15.itemid ) SELECT * FROM Join_16

tsql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT admissions.subject_id) FROM admissions WHERE admissions.hadm_id IN (SELECT prescriptions.hadm_id FROM prescriptions WHERE prescriptions.drug = 'fish oil (omega 3)' AND dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1)
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Predicate [ drug = 'fish oil (omega 3)' ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ starttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id ] ; #4 = Intersect [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #3.hadm_id = #1.hadm_id ] Distinct [ true ] Output [ #1.subject_id ] ; #5 = Aggregate [ #4 ] Output [ countstar AS Count_Star ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions WHERE drug = 'fish oil (omega 3)' ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Intersect_4 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT Scan_1.subject_id FROM Scan_1 WHERE hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM Filter_3) ), Aggregate_5 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Intersect_4 ) SELECT * FROM Aggregate_5

question: What were the three most frequently given diagnoses for patients who received anastomosis of hepatic duct to gastrointestinal tract previously within 2 months in 2100?

question: Retrieve the top three most frequent medications that patients were prescribed in the same month after being diagnosed with hyperlipidemia, unspecified since 2100.

question: How many patients received (aorto)coronary bypass of two coronary arteries treatment within the same month after being diagnosed with congestive heart failure, unspecified since 2100?

tsql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT T1.subject_id) FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'congestive heart failure, unspecified') AND dbo.MET_BY(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = '(aorto)coronary bypass of two coronary arteries') AND dbo.MET_BY(procedures_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND dbo.DURING(T1.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T2.charttime, 'month')) = 1
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'congestive heart failure, unspecified' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ d_icd_procedures ] Predicate [ long_title = '(aorto)coronary bypass of two coronary arteries' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #3 = Scan Table [ procedures_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Filter [ #3 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #5 = Join [ #2 , #4 ] Predicate [ #2.icd_code = #4.icd_code ] Output [ #4.hadm_id , #4.charttime ] ; #6 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #7 = Join [ #5 , #6 ] Predicate [ #5.hadm_id = #6.hadm_id ] Output [ #5.charttime , #6.subject_id ] ; #8 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #9 = Join [ #7 , #8 ] Predicate [ #7.subject_id = #8.subject_id ] Output [ #7.subject_id , #8.hadm_id , #7.charttime ] ; #10 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #11 = Filter [ #10 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT_START_OF(2100, NULL, NULL) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #12 = Join [ #9 , #11 ] Predicate [ #9.hadm_id = #11.hadm_id AND #11.charttime < #9.charttime AND #11.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#9.charttime, 'month') ] Output [ #11.icd_code , #9.subject_id ] ; #13 = Join [ #1 , #12 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #12.icd_code ] Distinct [ true ] Output [ #12.subject_id ] ; #14 = Aggregate [ #13 ] Output [ countstar AS Count_Star ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'congestive heart failure, unspecified' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_procedures WHERE long_title = '(aorto)coronary bypass of two coronary arteries' ), Scan_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.procedures_icd ), Filter_4 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_3 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_5 AS ( SELECT Filter_4.hadm_id, Filter_4.charttime FROM Scan_2 JOIN Filter_4 ON Scan_2.icd_code = Filter_4.icd_code ), Scan_6 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_7 AS ( SELECT Join_5.charttime, Scan_6.subject_id FROM Join_5 JOIN Scan_6 ON Join_5.hadm_id = Scan_6.hadm_id ), Scan_8 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_9 AS ( SELECT Join_7.subject_id, Scan_8.hadm_id, Join_7.charttime FROM Join_7 JOIN Scan_8 ON Join_7.subject_id = Scan_8.subject_id ), Scan_10 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_11 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_10 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1 ), Join_12 AS ( SELECT Filter_11.icd_code, Join_9.subject_id FROM Join_9 JOIN Filter_11 ON Join_9.hadm_id = Filter_11.hadm_id AND Filter_11.charttime < Join_9.charttime AND dbo.DURING(Filter_11.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(Join_9.charttime, 'month')) = 1 ), Join_13 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT Join_12.subject_id FROM Scan_1 JOIN Join_12 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Join_12.icd_code ), Aggregate_14 AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_13 ) SELECT * FROM Aggregate_14

question: Patient 10014078's chloride last measured on the last hospital visit is less than the second to last value measured on the last hospital visit?
