question: What are the three most frequently ordered medications that patients in their 40s were prescribed during the same month after they were diagnosed with hyperlipidemia, unspecified since 1 year ago?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'hyperlipidemia, unspecified' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 AND datetime(prescriptions.starttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.starttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'hyperlipidemia, unspecified') AND dbo.MET_BY(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 AND dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T1.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T2.starttime, 'month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'hyperlipidemia, unspecified' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate())) ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Predicate [ age >= 40 AND age <= 49 ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id , age ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ starttime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate())) ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.starttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#10.starttime, 'month') ] Output [ #10.drug ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ drug ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'hyperlipidemia, unspecified' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) = 1 ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Filter_3.hadm_id, Filter_3.charttime FROM Scan_1 JOIN Filter_3 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Filter_3.icd_code ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_6 AS ( SELECT Join_4.charttime, Scan_5.subject_id FROM Join_4 JOIN Scan_5 ON Join_4.hadm_id = Scan_5.hadm_id ), Scan_7 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id, age FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions WHERE age >= 40 AND age <= 49 ), Join_8 AS ( SELECT Join_6.charttime, Scan_7.hadm_id FROM Join_6 JOIN Scan_7 ON Join_6.subject_id = Scan_7.subject_id ), Scan_9 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions ), Filter_10 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM Scan_9 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) = 1 ), Join_11 AS ( SELECT Filter_10.drug FROM Join_8 JOIN Filter_10 ON Filter_10.hadm_id = Join_8.hadm_id AND Join_8.charttime < Filter_10.starttime AND dbo.DURING(Join_8.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(Filter_10.starttime, 'month')) = 1 ), Aggregate_12 AS ( SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_11 GROUP BY drug ), SequenceProject_13 AS ( SELECT drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_12 ), Filter_14 AS ( SELECT drug FROM SequenceProject_13 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 3 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_14

question: Which are the four most frequent lab tests given to patients in the same month after they are diagnosed with anticoagulants causing adverse effects in therapeutic use?

question: What was the drug that patient 10020740 was prescribed for within the same day after undergoing continuous invasive mechanical ventilation for less than 96 consecutive hours in 04/2100?

question: Among patients diagnosed with accidental fall on or from other stairs or steps since 2100, what are the top three medications prescribed within the same month to patients in their 30s?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'accidental fall on or from other stairs or steps' ) AND strftime('%Y',diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 AND strftime('%Y',prescriptions.starttime) >= '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.starttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3

tsql: SELECT d_items.label FROM d_items WHERE d_items.itemid IN (SELECT T1.itemid FROM (SELECT outputevents.itemid AS itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM outputevents WHERE dbo.MET_BY(outputevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1 GROUP BY outputevents.itemid) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 5)
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_items ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ outputevents ] Output [ charttime , itemid ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate())) ] Output [ itemid ] ; #4 = Aggregate [ #3 ] GroupBy [ itemid ] Output [ itemid , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #5 = SequenceProject [ #4 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ itemid , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #6 = Filter [ #5 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 5 ] Output [ itemid ] ; #7 = Intersect [ #1 , #6 ] Predicate [ #6.itemid = #1.itemid ] Output [ #1.label ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_items ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT charttime, itemid FROM mimic_iv.dbo.outputevents ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) = 1 ), Aggregate_4 AS ( SELECT itemid, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Filter_3 GROUP BY itemid ), SequenceProject_5 AS ( SELECT itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_4 ), Filter_6 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM SequenceProject_5 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 5 ), Intersect_7 AS ( SELECT Scan_1.label FROM Scan_1 WHERE itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM Filter_6) ) SELECT * FROM Intersect_7

question: Count the number of patients who received dilation of left external iliac vein with intraluminal device, percutaneous approach within 2 months after being diagnosed with operating room of hospital as the place of occurrence of the external cause in the last year.

tsql: SELECT d_labitems.label FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.itemid IN (SELECT T1.itemid FROM (SELECT labevents.itemid AS itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM labevents GROUP BY labevents.itemid) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 5)
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ labevents ] Output [ itemid ] ; #2 = Aggregate [ #1 ] GroupBy [ itemid ] Output [ itemid , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #3 = SequenceProject [ #2 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ itemid , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #4 = Filter [ #3 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 5 ] Output [ itemid ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ d_labitems ] Output [ itemid , label ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.itemid = #5.itemid ] Output [ #5.label ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM mimic_iv.dbo.labevents ), Aggregate_2 AS ( SELECT itemid, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Scan_1 GROUP BY itemid ), SequenceProject_3 AS ( SELECT itemid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_2 ), Filter_4 AS ( SELECT itemid FROM SequenceProject_3 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 5 ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT itemid, label FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_labitems ), Join_6 AS ( SELECT Scan_5.label FROM Filter_4 JOIN Scan_5 ON Filter_4.itemid = Scan_5.itemid ) SELECT * FROM Join_6

question: What is the average total cost for a hospital including tests in the rheumatoid factor laboratory?
sqlite: SELECT AVG(T1.C1) FROM ( SELECT SUM(cost.cost) AS C1 FROM cost WHERE cost.hadm_id IN ( SELECT labevents.hadm_id FROM labevents WHERE labevents.itemid IN ( SELECT d_labitems.itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE d_labitems.label = 'rheumatoid factor' ) ) GROUP BY cost.hadm_id ) AS T1

question: Tell me the top three most commonly prescribed medications within the same hospital visit to patients in their 50s who were diagnosed with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, unspecified since 2100.
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime, admissions.hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, unspecified' ) AND strftime('%Y',diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= '2100' ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime, admissions.hadm_id FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 AND strftime('%Y',prescriptions.starttime) >= '2100' ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, unspecified') AND dbo.MET_BY(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 AND dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT_START_OF_YMD(2100, NULL, NULL)) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3

tsql: SELECT T1.drug FROM (SELECT prescriptions.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM prescriptions WHERE dbo.MET_BY(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1 GROUP BY prescriptions.drug) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 5
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ starttime , drug ] ; #2 = Filter [ #1 ] Predicate [ starttime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate())) ] Output [ drug ] ; #3 = Aggregate [ #2 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #4 = SequenceProject [ #3 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #5 = Filter [ #4 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 5 ] Output [ drug ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT starttime, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions ), Filter_2 AS ( SELECT drug FROM Scan_1 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(starttime, dbo.TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) = 1 ), Aggregate_3 AS ( SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Filter_2 GROUP BY drug ), SequenceProject_4 AS ( SELECT drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_3 ), Filter_5 AS ( SELECT drug FROM SequenceProject_4 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 5 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_5

tsql: SELECT T1.spec_type_desc FROM (SELECT microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc AS spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM microbiologyevents WHERE dbo.DURING(microbiologyevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1 GROUP BY microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc) AS T1 WHERE T1.C1 <= 5
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ microbiologyevents ] Output [ charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #2 = Filter [ #1 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ spec_type_desc ] ; #3 = Aggregate [ #2 ] GroupBy [ spec_type_desc ] Output [ spec_type_desc , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #4 = SequenceProject [ #3 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ spec_type_desc , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #5 = Filter [ #4 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 5 ] Output [ spec_type_desc ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT charttime, spec_type_desc FROM mimic_iv.dbo.microbiologyevents ), Filter_2 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc FROM Scan_1 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(getdate(), 'year')) = 1 ), Aggregate_3 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Filter_2 GROUP BY spec_type_desc ), SequenceProject_4 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_3 ), Filter_5 AS ( SELECT spec_type_desc FROM SequenceProject_4 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 5 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_5

question: What are the five commonly ordered medications that patients aged 60 or above were prescribed within the same month after diagnosed with other nonspecific findings on examination of urine?

question: What are the three most commonly prescribed medications for patients diagnosed with other and unspecified hyperlipidemia previously within the same hospital visit, throughout this year?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime, admissions.hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'other and unspecified hyperlipidemia' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime, admissions.hadm_id FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE datetime(prescriptions.starttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'other and unspecified hyperlipidemia') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime, admissions.hadm_id AS hadm_id FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.DURING(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND T1.hadm_id = T2.hadm_id GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 3
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'other and unspecified hyperlipidemia' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id , #5.hadm_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.hadm_id = #7.hadm_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #6.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ prescriptions ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ starttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , starttime , drug ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.starttime ] Output [ #10.drug ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ drug ] Output [ drug , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ drug , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 3 ] Output [ drug ]

question: What are the four frequently ordered medications for patients diagnosed with hemorrhage of rectum and anus previously within 2 months, in this year?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'hemorrhage of rectum and anus' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE datetime(prescriptions.starttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T2.starttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4
tsql: SELECT T3.drug FROM (SELECT T2.drug AS drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'hemorrhage of rectum and anus') AND dbo.DURING(diagnoses_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, prescriptions.drug AS drug, prescriptions.starttime AS starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.DURING(prescriptions.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND dbo.DURING(T2.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T1.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.drug) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4

cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'hemorrhage of rectum and anus' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Filter_3 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code, charttime FROM Scan_2 WHERE dbo.DURING(charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(getdate(), 'year')) = 1 ), Join_4 AS ( SELECT Filter_3.hadm_id, Filter_3.charttime FROM Scan_1 JOIN Filter_3 ON Scan_1.icd_code = Filter_3.icd_code ), Scan_5 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_6 AS ( SELECT Join_4.charttime, Scan_5.subject_id FROM Join_4 JOIN Scan_5 ON Join_4.hadm_id = Scan_5.hadm_id ), Scan_7 AS ( SELECT subject_id, hadm_id FROM mimic_iv.dbo.admissions ), Join_8 AS ( SELECT Join_6.charttime, Scan_7.hadm_id FROM Join_6 JOIN Scan_7 ON Join_6.subject_id = Scan_7.subject_id ), Scan_9 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions ), Filter_10 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, starttime, drug FROM Scan_9 WHERE dbo.DURING(starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(getdate(), 'year')) = 1 ), Join_11 AS ( SELECT Filter_10.drug FROM Join_8 JOIN Filter_10 ON Filter_10.hadm_id = Join_8.hadm_id AND Join_8.charttime < Filter_10.starttime AND dbo.DURING(Filter_10.starttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(Join_8.charttime, 'within +2 month')) = 1 ), Aggregate_12 AS ( SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS Count_Star FROM Join_11 GROUP BY drug ), SequenceProject_13 AS ( SELECT drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count_Star DESC) AS dense_rank_1 FROM Aggregate_12 ), Filter_14 AS ( SELECT drug FROM SequenceProject_13 WHERE dense_rank_1 <= 4 ) SELECT * FROM Filter_14

question: What is the maximum total hospital cost for a patient suffering from acute edema of lung, unspecified since 1 year ago?

tsql: SELECT MAX(T1.C1) FROM (SELECT SUM(cost.cost) AS C1 FROM cost WHERE cost.hadm_id IN (SELECT diagnoses_icd.hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'acute edema of lung, unspecified')) AND dbo.MET_BY(cost.chargetime, dbo.TIME_POINT(DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()))) = 1 GROUP BY cost.hadm_id) AS T1
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ cost ] Output [ hadm_id , chargetime , cost ] ; #2 = Filter [ #1 ] Predicate [ chargetime MET_BY TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate())) ] Output [ hadm_id , cost ] ; #3 = Scan Table [ d_icd_diagnoses ] Predicate [ long_title = 'acute edema of lung, unspecified' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #4 = Scan Table [ diagnoses_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code ] ; #5 = Join [ #3 , #4 ] Predicate [ #3.icd_code = #4.icd_code ] Output [ #4.hadm_id ] ; #6 = Intersect [ #2 , #5 ] Predicate [ #5.hadm_id = #2.hadm_id ] Output [ #2.hadm_id , #2.cost ] ; #7 = Aggregate [ #6 ] GroupBy [ hadm_id ] Output [ SUM(cost) AS Sum_cost ] ; #8 = Aggregate [ #7 ] Output [ MAX(Sum_cost) AS Max_Sum_cost ]
cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, chargetime, cost FROM mimic_iv.dbo.cost ), Filter_2 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, cost FROM Scan_1 WHERE dbo.MET_BY(chargetime, dbo.TIME_POINT(dateadd(year, -1, getdate()))) = 1 ), Scan_3 AS ( SELECT icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.d_icd_diagnoses WHERE long_title = 'acute edema of lung, unspecified' ), Scan_4 AS ( SELECT hadm_id, icd_code FROM mimic_iv.dbo.diagnoses_icd ), Join_5 AS ( SELECT Scan_4.hadm_id FROM Scan_3 JOIN Scan_4 ON Scan_3.icd_code = Scan_4.icd_code ), Intersect_6 AS ( SELECT Filter_2.hadm_id, Filter_2.cost FROM Filter_2 WHERE hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM Join_5) ), Aggregate_7 AS ( SELECT SUM(cost) AS Sum_cost FROM Intersect_6 GROUP BY hadm_id ), Aggregate_8 AS ( SELECT MAX(Sum_cost) AS Max_Sum_cost FROM Aggregate_7 ) SELECT * FROM Aggregate_8

question: What are the five most frequently ordered medications that patients in their 50s were prescribed within 2 months after they were diagnosed with other specified procedures as the cause of abnormal reaction of patient, or of later complication, without mention of misadventure at time of procedure since 1 year ago?
sqlite: SELECT T3.drug FROM ( SELECT T2.drug, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, diagnoses_icd.charttime FROM diagnoses_icd JOIN admissions ON diagnoses_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_diagnoses.icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses WHERE d_icd_diagnoses.long_title = 'other specified procedures as the cause of abnormal reaction of patient, or of later complication, without mention of misadventure at time of procedure' ) AND datetime(diagnoses_icd.charttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.starttime FROM prescriptions JOIN admissions ON prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE admissions.age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 AND datetime(prescriptions.starttime) >= datetime(current_time,'-1 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.starttime AND datetime(T2.starttime) BETWEEN datetime(T1.charttime) AND datetime(T1.charttime,'+2 month') GROUP BY T2.drug ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 5

question: Name the three most frequently prescribed drugs in the same hospital visit following a diagnosis of pure hypercholesterolemia.

cte: WITH Scan_1 AS ( SELECT row_id, drug FROM mimic_iv.dbo.prescriptions WHERE drug = 'nicotine patch' ), Scan_2 AS ( SELECT event_id, cost, event_type FROM mimic_iv.dbo.cost WHERE event_type = 'prescriptions' ), Join_3 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT Scan_2.cost FROM Scan_1 JOIN Scan_2 ON Scan_1.row_id = Scan_2.event_id ) SELECT * FROM Join_3

question: How many patients received extirpation of matter from left lower lobe bronchus, via natural or artificial opening endoscopic treatment in the same month after having been diagnosed with other diseases of bronchus, not elsewhere classified since 2100?

question: What are the top three most frequent microbiology tests since 2100?

question: What were the top three most common microbiology tests for patients who were previously diagnosed with neoplasm of unspecified nature of endocrine glands and other parts of nervous system within the same hospital visit since 1 year ago?

question: What were the five most frequently diagnosed microbiology tests for patients who were diagnosed with cardiac arrest due to underlying cardiac condition before in the same hospital visit, in 2100?

question: The first time patient 10007795 was prescribed lactated ringers and gemfibrozil at the same time since 06/2100?

question: Among patients who underwent ileostomy, not otherwise specified since 2100, what were the top four most common procedures that followed within the same month?

question: What are the four most frequently tested specimens for patients that received parenteral infusion of concentrated nutritional substances previously in the same month in this year?
sqlite: SELECT T3.spec_type_desc FROM ( SELECT T2.spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) AS C1 FROM ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = ( SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'parenteral infusion of concentrated nutritional substances' ) AND datetime(procedures_icd.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T1 JOIN ( SELECT admissions.subject_id, microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc, microbiologyevents.charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE datetime(microbiologyevents.charttime,'start of year') = datetime(current_time,'start of year','-0 year') ) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND datetime(T1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(T2.charttime,'start of month') GROUP BY T2.spec_type_desc ) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4
tsql: SELECT T3.spec_type_desc FROM (SELECT T2.spec_type_desc AS spec_type_desc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC) AS C1 FROM (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime AS charttime FROM procedures_icd JOIN admissions ON procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE procedures_icd.icd_code = (SELECT d_icd_procedures.icd_code FROM d_icd_procedures WHERE d_icd_procedures.long_title = 'parenteral infusion of concentrated nutritional substances') AND dbo.DURING(procedures_icd.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T1 JOIN (SELECT admissions.subject_id AS subject_id, microbiologyevents.spec_type_desc AS spec_type_desc, microbiologyevents.charttime AS charttime FROM microbiologyevents JOIN admissions ON microbiologyevents.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id WHERE dbo.DURING(microbiologyevents.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(GETDATE(), 'year')) = 1) AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id WHERE T1.charttime < T2.charttime AND dbo.DURING(T1.charttime, dbo.TIME_INTERVAL_REL(T2.charttime, 'month')) = 1 GROUP BY T2.spec_type_desc) AS T3 WHERE T3.C1 <= 4
qpl: mimic_iv | #1 = Scan Table [ d_icd_procedures ] Predicate [ long_title = 'parenteral infusion of concentrated nutritional substances' ] Output [ icd_code ] ; #2 = Scan Table [ procedures_icd ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #3 = Filter [ #2 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , icd_code , charttime ] ; #4 = Join [ #1 , #3 ] Predicate [ #1.icd_code = #3.icd_code ] Output [ #3.hadm_id , #3.charttime ] ; #5 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #6 = Join [ #4 , #5 ] Predicate [ #4.hadm_id = #5.hadm_id ] Output [ #4.charttime , #5.subject_id ] ; #7 = Scan Table [ admissions ] Output [ subject_id , hadm_id ] ; #8 = Join [ #6 , #7 ] Predicate [ #6.subject_id = #7.subject_id ] Output [ #6.charttime , #7.hadm_id ] ; #9 = Scan Table [ microbiologyevents ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #10 = Filter [ #9 ] Predicate [ charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(getdate(), 'year') ] Output [ hadm_id , charttime , spec_type_desc ] ; #11 = Join [ #8 , #10 ] Predicate [ #10.hadm_id = #8.hadm_id AND #8.charttime < #10.charttime AND #8.charttime DURING TIME_INTERVAL(#10.charttime, 'month') ] Output [ #10.spec_type_desc ] ; #12 = Aggregate [ #11 ] GroupBy [ spec_type_desc ] Output [ spec_type_desc , countstar AS Count_Star ] ; #13 = SequenceProject [ #12 ] Over [ Count_Star DESC ] Output [ spec_type_desc , dense_rank() AS dense_rank_1 ] ; #14 = Filter [ #13 ] Predicate [ dense_rank_1 <= 4 ] Output [ spec_type_desc ]
